svg.text: A Tight keyboard pitch: 19.05 x 19.05 mm
Pixel sits in the 5 mm gap under each key. Gap is 5.05 mm: no wall for light baffles, 10 mm boards do not fit.
Same tight columns, 9 mm extra per row for a pixel above each key. A 10 mm board just touches the keycap footprints.
Roomy: label strip, baffle walls and finger clearance. Pitch is free because you have individual pixels.
All three drawn to the same scale. Dimensions are nominal; check your own pixels and keycaps.
